newsitem.title: USA: Lehman declines comment on report.
newsitem.headline: Lehman declines comment on report.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc said it knew of no business reason to account for unusual activity in its shares and declined to confirm or deny a report naming the firm as a possible takeover candidate.
Late last week, an article in Business Week magazine named Lehman as a possible takeover candidate and cited an unidentified banker as saying the firm was actively in talks.
"We don't respond to scurrilous rumors," Lehman spokesman William Ahearn said.

He said the company had not issued any statement nor did it know of any corporate developments that would explain a sharp price increase and unusually high volume in the company's shares over the past two sessions.
Rumors of a Lehman merger have surfaced repeatedly since the company's 1994 spin-off from American Express Co.

Shares in Lehman were up 1/4 at 23 but rose as much as 1-1/2 in early activity after climbing 1-1/8 on Friday. Lehman shares were among the New York Stock Exchange's most active issues with more than 780,000 shares traded on the Big Board.
